channel.title: HiRISE: High Resolution Imaging Science Experiment (NASA)
channel.description: Updates from the HiRISE camera onboard the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (MRO/NASA). We are based at the University of Arizona in Tucson, Ariz.

item.title: HiPOD: Glacial and Periglacial Terrains
item.description: This image will help define the fine-grained shapes of a glacial terrain just east of a periglacial mantle that appeared in earlier HiRISE observation. The periglacial terrain lays on top of a mantle that may retain the cratering history of the region. We also can constrain the age of the area. (NASA/JPL-Caltech/University of Arizona)
